english:
Saturday: Of the Saints: Gregory the Wonderworker, Nicholas the Patriarch [Hierarch], and Myron the Bishop. Tone 1 [ak]: Who adorned (Ork zardaretsin) with its proper [hymns]. Magnificat [Mankunk] and Midday [Liturgy] Tone 2 [bz]: Who with light (Or loosov). Midday Psalm 131 [132]: Your priests. Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 10:9: Wisdom [delivered] the merciful to verse 12: godliness. Prophet Malachi 2:5: Thus says the Lord to verse 7: of the Almighty. Catholic Epistle 1 Peter 5:1 to the elders to verse 7: for you. Alleluia: Your priests. Gospel John 10:11: I am the shepherd to verse 14–16: and one shepherd.

First Sunday of Advent [Yisnakats]. Canticle [Harts]: Of the Resurrection. Midday Psalm 64 [65]: Praise is due to you. Prophet Isaiah 36:1: And it came to pass in the fourteenth year to verse 9: on their horses. Apostle 1 Thessalonians 1:1: Paul and Silvanus to verse 10: which is to come. Alleluia: From the Tone. Gospel Luke 12:13: One of the multitude said to verse 21: [shall be] added to you.

Monday: Of the Holy Virgins: Juliana and Vasilouhi. Canticle [Harts] of the Martyrs. Magnificat [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [dk]: Commemoration (Yishatak) of Christ. Midday Psalm 44 [45]: Shall be brought to the king. Book of Song of Songs 8:14: Flee, my beloved to verse 24 [8:14]: uncorrupted. Prophet Hosea 13:6: Thus says the Lord to verse 8: shall be Ephraim's. Apostle 2 Corinthians 6:16: For you are the temple to verse 7:1: in the fear of God. Alleluia: The queen shall stand. Gospel Luke 8:1: And it came to pass afterward to verse 3: of their substance.

Tuesday: Of the Saints: Lucian the Priest, Taracus, Probus, Andronicus, and Onesimus, and the other disciples of Paul. Tone 3 [gk]: Heavenly Wisdom (Imastootiun yerknayin) with its proper [hymns]. Midday Psalm 18 [19]: Through all. Proverbs [Wisdom of Solomon] 9:9: The Lord is with you to verse 12: the throne of my father. Prophet Isaiah 41:15: Thus says the Lord to verse 19: the oil tree. Apostle 2 Corinthians 2:14: But thanks be to God to verse 17: we speak in Christ. Alleluia: You shall make them. Gospel Luke 6:13: And when it was day to verse 20: the kingdom of God.

Wednesday: Canticle [Harts] of Penitence. Midday Psalm 85 [86]: Save your servant. Apostle 1 Thessalonians 2:1: For yourselves know to verse 12: and into glory. Alleluia: From the Tone. Gospel Luke 12:41: Peter said to verse 48: they shall ask of him.

Thursday: Of the Saints: Clement the Patriarch [Hierarch], and Bagarat [Patriarch] of Taormina the Bishop. Canticle [Harts] Tone 3 [g3]: Who your boundless. Magnificat [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [g3]: Children of the New Zion (Mankunk nor sioni). Midday Hymn Tone 8 [dz]: The leaders (Zarajnords). Psalm 131 [132]: Priests. Proverbs 8:33: Hear instruction [wisdom] to verse 36: love death. Prophet Isaiah 66:18: Thus says the Lord to verse 21: to the Levites, says the Lord. Apostle Philippians 3:1: Finally, my brethren to verse 7: in Christ Jesus. Alleluia: Priests. Gospel Luke 9:1: And having called the twelve to verse 6: everywhere.

Friday: Canticle [Harts] of Rest. Midday Psalm 97 [98]: Have seen all. Apostle 1 Thessalonians 2:17: But we, brethren to verse 19: of Jesus Christ. Alleluia: From the Tone. Gospel Luke 12:49: I came to cast fire to verse 59: the last penny.

Saturday: Of the Holy Apostles and our first illuminators: Thaddeus and Bartholomew. Tone 3 [g3]: Blessed (Yerandeli) with its proper [hymns]. King forever. Today the ranks of angels. Midday Psalm: Through all the earth. Book of Wisdom of Solomon 9:13: For what man is he to verse 10:2: to have power over all things. Prophet Jeremiah 16:16: Thus says the Lord to verse 19: in the day of evils. Apostle 1 Corinthians 12:26: And if one member suffers to verse 14:10: shall be abolished. Alleluia: You shall make them. Gospel Matthew 9:35: And Jesus went about to verse 10:7: the kingdom of heaven.

Second Sunday of Advent [Yisnakats]. Canticle [Harts] of the Resurrection. Midday Psalm 64 [65]: Praise is due to you. Prophet Isaiah 36:22:
